summary: Backend and frontend testing for Personalized Recipes feature (Dashboard + Catalog Tabs). Backend: 14/14 tests passed. Fixed a bug in Dashboard recipe loading that was using state variable before it was set. Frontend: Recipes catalog shows two tabs (For you / All Recipes), personalized recipes show relevance_tags and star badges, all recipes tab shows generic recipes without personalization data.

bug_fixed.issue: Dashboard was calling generic /api/recipes instead of personalized endpoint because the code used state variable 'profileId' before it was set. Changed to fetch profileId fresh from AsyncStorage inside the recipe loading block.
bug_fixed.fix_description: Added 'const localProfileId = await AsyncStorage.getItem('health_profile_id');' before recipe fetch to ensure profileId is available
